description: This file defines a decorator class for the BuzzLikeOnComment entity within an HR management system, providing methods to set employee and comment references and to format liked date/time information.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that encapsulates operations for BuzzLikeOnComment entities, including setting references to employee and comment entities, and formatting timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a BuzzLikeOnComment entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee reference for the like based on the employee number.

methods.name: setCommentByCommentId
methods.description: Sets the comment reference for the like based on the comment ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the comment was liked, formatted as a date string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the comment was liked, formatted as a time string.
